senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. שָׁלָה)to draw out; to stretch forth; to send.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 3:2">Erub. III, 2</cite> <he>השׁוֹלֵחַ ערובו וכ׳</he> if one sends his ‘Erub (<cite ref="P01306"><he>עֵרוּב</he></cite>) forth to be laid by a deaf and dumb person.
<cite ref="Chullin 59b:7">Ḥull. 59ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>שָׁלְחוּ מתם</he> they sent word from there (from Palestine to Babylonia).
<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 4:1">Gitt. IV, 1</cite> <he>השולח גט וכ׳</he> if a man sends a letter of divorce to his wife &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 6:4">B. Kam. VI, 4</cite>, v. <cite ref="B01065"><he>בְּעֵרָה</he></cite>.

Ib. ש׳ ביד פיקח (ib. 60ᵃ שִׁילֵּחַ) if he sent out fire through a sane person; a. fr.—Part. pass. שָׁלוּחַ q. v.—ש׳ יד ב־ [to stretch out a hand against,] to make illegitimate use of, to misappropriate (Ex. XXII, 10).
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 3:12">B. Mets. III, 12</cite> <he>השולח יד בפקדון</he> if a person makes use of a trust.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 3:12">Ib.</cite> <he>החושב לִשְׁלוֹחַ יד וכ׳</he> if he declares his intention to use a trust; <he>אינו חייב עד שיִשְׁלַח בו יד</he> he is not responsible (for loss), until he has used it; a. fr.

senses.gloss: same, to send; to send away, dismiss.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 1:9">Bets. I, 9</cite> <he>אין מְשַׁלְּחִין בי״ט וכ׳</he> on the Holy Day you dare not send (to a friend) anything except portions (of eatables, ready for use); <he>משלחין בהמה וכ׳</he> you may send cattle … alive or slaughtered.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 12:3">Ḥull. XII, 3</cite> <he>שִׁלְּחָהּ וחזרה</he> if he sent the mother bird away, and she came back.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 12:3">Ib.</cite> <he>אמר … ומְשַׁלֵּחַ הבנים</he> if he says, I will take the mother, and send the young away; <he>חייב לשַׁלֵּחַ</he> he is bound to send her away.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 21">Gen. R. s. 21</cite> <he>שִׁלְּחוֹ מגן … ושלחו וכ׳</he> he banished him (Adam) from the paradise of this world and from that of the other world; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be sent off; to be commissioned.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 6:2">Yoma VI, 2</cite>, a. e. <cite ref="E00942"><he>המִשְׁתַּלֵּחַ</he></cite> the goat that is to be sent away (<cite ref="Leviticus 16:10">Lev. XVI, 10</cite>), the scapegoat. Ib. 1 <he>נשפך … המשתלח</he> if the blood (of the goat designated for sacrifice) was spilt, the scapegoat is to be put to death (cannot be used for the ceremony).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 49:2">Gen. R. s. 49</cite> <he>מעשה באחד שנש׳ לגבות וכ׳</he> it happened that one was commissioned to tax the inhabitants &c.; a. fr.
